usage: 一分鐘 (one minute) is a measure of time used to indicate the duration of 60 seconds.
It can be used to express the length of an action or event, e.g. waiting or cooking.
It often works as a time unit in everyday conversations, such as scheduling or estimating.
When talking about time, 一分鐘 can be used with verbs like '等' (wait) or '開會' (have a meeting).
It can be part of phrases to encourage quick action, for example, '等一分鐘' means 'wait one minute'.
